availability: The stable asset URL identifies the corresponding-source companion. Verify the complete size, SHA256 and closed membership after retrieval; this descriptor does not attest live availability or delivery state.

archive.format: gzip-compressed POSIX tar; regular files only

reconstruction.extraction: After verification, extract into a fresh directory. Paths beneath the archive root mirror the public reconstruction kit; source-inputs/ contains unchanged upstream files.
reconstruction.compilerLimit: Prebuilt locked SDK/LLVM/Binaryen and Alpine guest binaries are separate fetchable build inputs; complete source compiler bootstrap and historical kernel/firmware environment reconstruction are not claimed.

identityMeaning: New neutral source archive. Reacquired source bytes do not establish recovery of a historical whole-file archive or historical source delivery.
